summary: All 4 tasks (A: Go Live button visibility, B: live chat input existence, C: profile avatar expand to lightbox, D: wall post media save + Inner Circle gating) verified successfully on the Vite/React web preview at mobile viewport (390x844). Used dev-token auth per /app/memory/test_credentials.md; set avatar via PUT /api/profile; created public + inner posts via POST /api/posts for TASK D.

TASK_A_live_start_btn_visible.details: live-start-btn bbox y=400 h=52 (viewport 844). Fully visible on screen and positioned below live-save-toggle.

TASK_B_live_chat_bar.details: live-chat-input and live-chat-send are present in LiveModal.tsx LiveStage (lines 282-284). Live stage not reached in automation due to camera/mic unavailability — environment limitation, not a code bug. Chat bar also has keyboard-aware offset via visualViewport (lines 105-116 and style on line 273).

TASK_C_profile_avatar_expand.details: Tapping profile-story-avatar on /u/livetester (no active story) opened media-lightbox with lightbox-close button. Smooth scale/opacity entrance animation implemented in MediaLightbox.tsx (lines 46, 153).

TASK_D_save_media_and_gating.details: Public post rendered post-media-save button; clicking it did not error. Lightbox for public post showed lightbox-save button. Inner Circle post did NOT render post-media-save and lightbox for inner post did NOT show lightbox-save button. Gating via `canSave = post.tier !== 'inner'` in PostCard.tsx line 58 works correctly.

critical_code_review_comments: saveMedia (/app/frontend/src/lib/saveMedia.ts): the CORS-fallback branch returns true even when it only opens a new tab — the UI will show the 'done' tick even if no download actually started. Low priority but could mislead users. Consider returning false on fallback so the save-state stays idle.

PostCard.tsx: single `saveState` is shared across all media buttons on a card (header save and lightbox save); if a user has multiple media in a carousel, parallel clicks would clobber state. Acceptable for current UX.
seed_data_creation: Created avatar + 2 posts (TEST public media, TEST inner media) under user handle 'livetester' via dev-token on the Render backend. These remain on the Render DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dev-token flow works (POST /api/dev/token + /api/auth/dob 1995-06-15). The /api/auth/dob call returns 400 for already-set DOB on repeat runs but is harmless. Onboarding modal: click 'Next' x3 then 'Enter Skali'. For media tests, create posts via POST /api/posts with tier public/inner. The TEST_* posts from this run exist on the Render DB; be aware of accumulating data.
